preview.newThemes: Has anyone tried the new themes? 🌸
preview.favorite: Yes! {theme} is my favorite so far
appearance.themeHint: The colors of the whole app: the waifu.dev themes, and any you make.
appearance.followSystemHint: A light theme by day and a dark one by night, as your system switches.
appearance.densityHint: How much room messages and lists get.
appearance.cozyHint: Avatars, and names over each run of messages.
appearance.compactDisplayHint: Time and name in front of every line.
appearance.zoomHint: The size of everything, applied when you let go.
themes.builtin.sakura: Soft cherry blossom pink. The default.
themes.builtin.yoru: Late night coding under neon signs.
themes.builtin.matcha: Calm green tea and warm paper.
themes.builtin.tsundere: It's not like I made this theme for you or anything.
themes.yourThemesHint: Made, tuned or imported here. They work on every instance you use on this device.
themes.tooBig: That file is too big to be a theme.
themes.pictureNeedsInstance: Its background picture needs an instance to live on; open one you're signed in to and import it again.

themes.full.one: That's {count} theme, as many as fuwa keeps. Delete it to add another.
themes.full.other: That's {count} themes, as many as fuwa keeps. Delete one to add another.

themes.fromBuiltinHint: Make your own version of one of the Waifu Devs themes.
themes.drop: Drop a theme file to import it
themes.emptyHint: Start from the theme you're using, pick your colors, add a background picture and an effect. Or drop a theme file here.
themes.name: Name
themes.colorsHint: The main colors; the rest are made from them.
themes.cornersHint: How round buttons, cards and fields are.
themes.backdropHint: A picture and an effect that come with this theme.
themes.ownBackdropHint: Off, it uses your Background setting like any theme.
backgrounds.title: Background and effect
backgrounds.hint: Behind the app on this device, for every instance.
backgrounds.themeHasOwn: {theme} brings its own backdrop, shown in the preview. This one is for your other themes.
backdrop.pictureHint: Uploaded to your instance and kept with your account there. Only fuwa instances serve backgrounds.
backdrop.effectGpu: Moving effects are drawn on your GPU, at most 30 frames a second, and stop while fuwa is hidden.
backdrop.effectCss: This browser has no WebGPU, so moving effects use a lighter version drawn with CSS.
backdrop.panelsHint: How solid the sidebar and chat are over the backdrop. More solid reads better.
backdrop.pickType: Pick a PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP or AVIF picture.
backdrop.delete: Delete this background from your instance
backdrop.needInstance: Open an instance you're signed in to, to upload pictures to it.
backdrop.effect.auroraHint: Slow ribbons of the theme's colors.
backdrop.effect.customHint: A shader you write, or one a theme brought.
shader.name: Shader name
shader.starter.glow: A soft light that follows your pointer.
shader.starter.plasma: Melting colors, like a lava lamp.
shader.keepsLast: The preview keeps the last version that worked until this one compiles.
shader.runningThird: Running at a third of resolution
shader.write: Write {signature} in WGSL. Return a color and how much it covers what's behind, 0 to 1.
shader.input.uv: This pixel, 0 to 1 across and down (0, 0 is the top left).
shader.input.time: Seconds, scaled by Speed. Stands still with reduced motion.
shader.input.res: The size drawn, in pixels. res.x / res.y is the aspect.
shader.input.pointer: The pointer in the same 0..1 as uv, eased. Outside 0..1 when it's off the window.
shader.input.intensity: Strength, 0 to 1. fuwa applies it for you.
shader.input.noise: A random number, smooth noise and layered noise, all 0 to 1.
shader.limits: That's all a shader can reach: no pictures, no links, no other files. It runs at most 30 times a second, and fuwa lowers its resolution, or shows the fallback, when it's too heavy for this device.
accessibility.motionSystemCalm: Your system asks for less motion, so fuwa keeps it calm.
accessibility.motionSystemMoves: Your system is fine with motion, so fuwa moves.
accessibility.motionOff: Springs, slides and sparkles are off.
accessibility.motionOn: Everything moves, whatever your system says.
accessibility.motionSystemHint: Calmer when your system asks for less motion.
accessibility.motionReduceHint: Fades instead of springs and slides.
accessibility.saturationHint: Softens every color in the app, down to greys.
accessibility.roleColorsHint: Roles can give people's names a color. Show it on the name, as a dot beside it, or not at all.
accessibility.roleBesideHint: A dot in the role's color.
accessibility.effectsHint: Petals, stars and the like that people put on their profile cards.
accessibility.effectsStill: With motion calmed, effects show as a still picture.
accessibility.effectsToggle: Show effects on other people's cards
accessibility.effectsToggleHint: Your own always shows to you, so you can see what others do.
accessibility.linksToggleHint: So links stand out by more than their color.
accessibility.linksSample: The docs are at {link} if you get stuck.
chat.sendWithHint: The other one starts a new line.
chat.newLineMarkdown: {keys} for a new line, handy for long Markdown.
notifications.streamerQuietBoth: Streamer mode is on and keeps notifications and sounds quiet.
notifications.streamerQuietSounds: Streamer mode is on and keeps sounds quiet.
notifications.streamerQuietNotifications: Streamer mode is on and keeps notifications quiet.
notifications.desktopToggle: Notify me while fuwa isn't in front
notifications.blocked: Your browser blocks notifications for this site. Allow them in the site's settings, then switch this on.
notifications.asks: Your browser asks for permission the first time.
notifications.unreadBadgeToggle: Show unread messages in the tab's title and icon
notifications.unreadBadgeToggleHint: So you can tell from another tab.
notifications.soundMessageHint: In a channel you aren't looking at.
notifications.soundJoinHint: In the server you have open.
voice.systemSpeakers: This browser plays calls through the system's speakers.
voice.micTestHint: Say something and watch the bar. It turns green when what you say would go out.
voice.hearMyselfHint: Use headphones, or you'll hear an echo.
voice.pushToTalkHint: Goes out while you hold a key.
voice.autoSensitivityHint: Follows the noise in your room.
voice.echoHint: Keeps your speakers out of your microphone.
voice.noiseHint: Softens fans, keyboards and the street.
voice.gainHint: Evens out how loud you are. Off for a studio microphone.
voice.cameraQualityHint: Your camera goes out as sharp and smooth as it can, up to 1080p at 60 frames a second. Pick less to spare your connection. An instance or a server can hold everyone to less.
voice.mirrorHint: Only for you: everyone else sees it the right way round.
voice.cuesHint: Little cues while you're in a call.
voice.playCues: Play: joining, leaving, mute and deafen
keybinds.about: Shortcuts work while fuwa is in front, in the browser too. Global ones that work from other apps, like push to talk, come with the desktop app.
keybinds.customHint: Extra shortcuts for any action, on top of the ones below.
keybinds.recording: Press the keys for this shortcut, or Escape to stop
keybinds.browserKeeps: Your browser keeps {keys} for itself. The desktop app can use it.
keybinds.action.toggleCamera: Turn your camera on or off
keybinds.action.toggleRecording: Record the call, or stop and save it
keybinds.action.toggleStreamer: Turn streamer mode on or off
streamer.title: Streamer mode
streamer.hint: Hides what a stream shouldn't show while you share your screen.
streamer.shortcut: Turn it on or off anywhere with {keys}
streamer.hidePersonalHint: A self-hosted address can be a home IP. Addresses turn into a name like {alias} in fuwa's links and pages. The browser still shows this page's own address in its bar, so share the page itself or use the desktop app.
streamer.muteNotificationsHint: Messages don't pop up over the game.
streamer.auto: Turn on when OBS or XSplit goes live
streamer.autoHint: Needs to see which programs run, so it comes with the desktop app.
advanced.developerToggle: Show Copy ID on servers, channels, people and messages
advanced.developerToggleHint: Handy for bots, the API and bug reports.
advanced.reportsToggle: Send anonymous reports of errors and slow spots
advanced.reportsToggleHint: Counts only, so we can find and fix what breaks or drags.
advanced.sentErrors: Kinds of errors, and where in the app they happened
advanced.sentTimings: How long things took: starting up, catching up, calls connecting, requests, slow frames
advanced.sentUsage: How often a few features are used, like sending a message or sharing your screen
advanced.sentVersion: This app's version, your browser family and OS family
advanced.neverNames: Names, file names, ids or links
advanced.neverAddress: Your address, or anything that tells you apart
advanced.goesTo: Goes only to {instance}, which adds it to its hourly report to Waifu Devs. Instances whose owners turned telemetry off get nothing.
advanced.goesNowhere: None of your instances take reports right now (their owners turned telemetry off, or you're signed out), so nothing leaves this browser.
